title: Dither Background
concept: Orca Massif Rescue: a volunteer mountain rescue team's site set over a fixed 4×4 Bayer-dithered field where a monochrome massif sits under drifting cloud masses, with a live callout board and Clear / Spindrift / Whiteout conditions that ease the cloud density.
notes: Canvas 2D following the skill recipe (Bayer 4×4, six-step near-black to white palette, fbm clouds + wave drift, off-axis vignette); adds a per-column ridge line, lit west face and valley fog. Drawn at one pixel per cell and upscaled with image-rendering: pixelated (7 px cells, 6 px on phones), ~30 fps, paused when hidden; the massif sinks as you scroll. Reduced motion renders a single still frame and redraws on scroll or mode change. No WebGL or CDN dependencies.
